subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: After positive live proof is supplied, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961?
rationale: Both branches repair the same message-delivery boundary with slightly different test and schema scope, so landing direction requires one owner-backed canonical choice to avoid competing behavior and duplicated maintenance.

options.title: Retain this branch
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical branch after it supplies redacted live Discord/Codex continuation and exactly-once delivery proof.

options.title: Prefer the sibling branch
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 if maintainers want its schema-description change, after requiring equivalent positive live proof.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep both unmerged until an affected-area owner decides whether runtime classification alone or runtime plus schema wording is the desired permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Retain this branch
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical branch after it supplies redacted live Discord/Codex continuation and exactly-once delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current Codex source-reply completion behavior and is best positioned to reconcile continuation with stranded-reply recovery semantics.
